text:
marta (eng-platform): quick heads-up — planning a split of CI runners by region + separate GH orgs for billing. goal: cut cross-region egress and give teams local capacity. starting a short planning thread.

leo (devex): coming in with a 2-step plan: 1) label runners and create staged pools; 2) opt-in repo changes and org moves. keep it reversible.

jo (eng-sre): we need a safe drain. suggested cmd: `runnerctl drain --pool=emea --grace=600s` and a prom gate `runner_jobs_active == 0` before delete.

anya (eng-security): security checklist: create target orgs, rotate GH App tokens post-install, update OIDC audiences, audit repo perms. some legal signoffs may be required for billing accounts.

frank (infra): infra note: AMIs currently reference regional endpoints for SSM/metrics. will parameterize AMI build and add per-org IAM role templates. also will enforce cost tags at provision.

leo (devex): sample workflow diff to opt-in:```yaml
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: [self-hosted, linux, region-emea]
```
we'll provide a sed patch.

marta (eng-platform): deliverables: devex = playbook + sample patches; sres = drain runbook + dashboard; security = token rotation timeline; infra = AMI/IaC list. target: share draft plan by EOD Wednesday.

deploy-bot: webhook-check POST https://hooks.redwood.dev/ci-health -> 200 OK {"ok":true}. supports `X-Hub-Signature-256`.

jo (eng-sre): blocker: customers on custom contracts may delay org creation. add a 2-week contingency window.

anya (eng-security): noted; I'll sync with GTM/legal for those accounts.

marta (eng-platform): thanks — I'll post the kickoff doc link here when ready and book a 30m sync Monday 9am PT. :thumbsup:
